applies_to: data/golden.jsonl, with retrieved contexts and citations supplied by the SUT

deterministic_checks.retrieval_hit: At least one retrieved context comes from the same docs page as the case's source_url (fragment ignored).
deterministic_checks.cited: The response includes at least one citation.
deterministic_checks.citation_correct: At least one citation points to the case's source_url page.
deterministic_checks.citations_valid: Every citation is an https://playwright.dev/ URL.
deterministic_checks.citations_in_context: Every cited page was among the retrieved contexts (a citation to a page the SUT never retrieved is fabricated).
deterministic_checks.unsupported_identifiers: Inline-code spans in the response (APIs, flags, options) that do not appear in any retrieved context. A hallucination signal; reported, not gating.

judge_criteria.name: faithfulness
judge_criteria.question: Is every factual claim in the response supported by the retrieved contexts? Ignore whether the claim is true in general; judge only support from the contexts.

levels.0: A claim contradicts the contexts or the answer is mostly unsupported
levels.1: Mostly supported, but at least one detail is not in the contexts
levels.2: Every claim is supported by the contexts

notes: A response can be correct but ungrounded (right answer from model memory, not the contexts); that is a grounding failure. Retrieval metrics are reported separately so retrieval and generation failures can be told apart.
